what_it_is: A save file from the MiSTer Saturn core (internal backup RAM only, 64 KiB byte-expanded). The converter's test code says: 'Some files we were given from the mister are byte expanded out with 0x00 ... This one was done with 0x00'. Holds DAYTONA96_0 (records). Made by an early core build (before cart support, late 2024); later builds fill with 0xFF.
note: Provenance from the test's own comment in frontend/tests/unit/save-formats/Mister/SegaSaturn.spec.js and from Saturn_MiSTer issue #283, where the converter author describes the MiSTer files he was given.
